issues.description: Field visibility mismatch: In class de.tum.in.ase.eist.model.Person the field 'firstName' is declared with different access modifiers. The template repository declares 'private String firstName' while the solution repository declares 'public String firstName'. This inconsistency may confuse students about the intended encapsulation (whether direct field access is acceptable) and leads to inconsistent example code and API usage across artifacts.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the access modifier of Person.firstName consistent between template and solution. Prefer making the field private in both artifacts and use the existing getter/setter methods (getFirstName()/setFirstName()) to access it. Update the solution's Person.java to declare 'private String firstName' to match the template and preserve encapsulation; alternatively, if the public field is intentional, document that design choice and change the template to match.
